scope: Complete 171 original requests per profile, including all raw output buffers and canaries, indexed metadata, tokens/pieces, enum keys and logits. Six malformed tensor-payload requests are retained with an explicit authoring erratum; corrected pairs are additional cases. No expectation is generated from Rust.
format: MMEX0001 + u64 records_len + records + u64 pool_len + literal pooled bytes; all little-endian integer fields. models.bin deduplicates only complete byte-identical input files. The adapter reconstructs every original typed JSON value before success.
